prepare-material: Bring, arrange or shape the materials that a later act uses.
place-deposit: Place prepared objects beneath or beside the patient for a later act.
remove-deposit: Take away a deposit after its prescribed period beside the patient.
purify-by-analogy: Apply a named material to the patient while speaking a cleansing analogy.
make-offering: Give named food, drink or an animal to a divine or personified recipient.
invoke-help: Speak an appeal or command to a divine or personified recipient.
collect-material: Gather a named substance for later ritual handling.
construct-setting: Prepare the bounded place or structure used for the rite.
fashion-figure: Make a material figure or substitute.
mark-subject: Dress, adorn or orient the person undergoing the rite.
transfer-affliction: Move an affliction or dangerous condition onto a material carrier by gesture or speech.
destroy-affliction: Melt, break or burn a material carrier associated with the affliction.
wash-clean: Use a named liquid or implement to cleanse the person.
remove-mark: Take away clothing, wool or other material placed on the person.
discard-carrier: Send used ritual objects away from the person.
cross-threshold: Move the person through a prescribed boundary.
affirm-cleansing: Return to a recipient and state that the cleansing has been accomplished.
seek-fertility: Use a living exemplar in a request for offspring or increase.
dispatch-substitute: Send a substitute away from the affected group.
appease-divinity: Seek peace or acceptance from a divine recipient.
return-harm: Ask that harm return to its maker.
sleep-over-deposit: Keep a prepared deposit beneath the patient overnight.
cook-offering: Cook a named animal after it has been killed.
kill-for-offering: Kill a named animal as part of a prescribed offering sequence.
clear-setting: Gather ritual implements as the rite concludes.
seal-threshold: Close or anoint a doorway as a boundary against unwanted influence.
read-omen: Observe a bird as a ritual omen.
carry-dead: Carry the dead person to the place of cremation.
cremate-dead: Burn the dead person after carrying the body outside.
place-in-carrier: Load prepared materials into the basket that will carry them away.
chant-at-threshold: Sound a ritual cry as the carrier crosses the gate.
confess-offence: Acknowledge before a god the offence identified as the cause of the harm.
promise-restitution: Undertake to perform a neglected rite or give compensation to an offended god.
seek-divine-disclosure: Ask a god to reveal an unknown cause or demand by dream, oracle or inspired person.
disable-enemy: Speak or act so that an opponent's force is quelled, cooled or seized.
apply-remedy: Apply a prepared remedy to the patient's body.
prepare-remedy: Gather, dry, crush, mix or steep materials into a medical remedy.
administer-remedy: Give a prepared remedy to the patient to drink or eat, or apply it to the body.
expose-remedy: Leave a remedy outdoors overnight, under the stars, before it is used.
recite-incantation: Speak a prescribed incantation that accompanies a medical treatment.
